svg.title: Wall time of one run of three model calls against a stub
svg.desc: A dot chart of milliseconds per run on the Mac, 200 runs per program, against a local stub that answers each model call at once. Medians: plain openai loop 4.1 ms, ChatOpenAI bind_tools loop 4.46 ms, create_agent 7.67 ms, create_agent with InMemorySaver 8.94 ms.
svg.text: Each dot is one run of three model calls and two tool calls, 200 per program.
The black line is the median. Warm-up runs are left out.
